# Personal Blog Project Instructions

You are helping build a minimalist personal website using Astro.

## Goals

- Generate clean, maintainable Astro components.
- Keep JavaScript to a minimum.
- Prefer semantic HTML.
- Make every page responsive.
- Prioritize accessibility.
- Optimize for SEO.
- Use modern CSS without frameworks.
- Use reusable components whenever possible.

## Design

- Background: #F5F5F5 (Whitesmoke)
- Cards: White
- Text: #222222
- Secondary text: #666666
- Accent color: #2563EB
- Rounded corners: 10px
- Soft shadows only
- Plenty of whitespace

## Style

Inspired by modern engineering blogs.

Avoid flashy animations.

Avoid gradients.

Avoid glassmorphism.

Avoid dark themes for now.

## Blog

Blog posts are written in Markdown.

Generate components that support Markdown content.

## Performance

Favor static generation.

Keep CSS lightweight.

Avoid unnecessary dependencies.
